explication: LibreTranslate is a self-hosted machine-translation API and web interface powered by Argos Translate. The principal workflow enters through the Flask application, resolves languages and translates text, then returns the result. The application also exposes language detection, supported-language and health endpoints, file translation/download, suggestions, and a browser UI. Startup initializes translation models and shared storage/cache. The sampled excerpts show these entry points and several internal components; wiring for unsampled endpoints and helpers is represented only where README or sampled code supports it.
